questions.question: How long does a station last on batteries when it measures every ten minutes?
questions.reference: About 14 months on two 18650 cells (accelerated simulation).
questions.answer:
The only figure in Flux is from Piotr Zieliński's battery test: at a 10-minute measuring interval, a station lasted 14 months on two 18650 cells, but that was an accelerated simulation [1]. Treat it as a rough estimate, not a field result.

Firmware has changed since then. Later messages say stations report every 3 minutes after 2.3.0 and 2.5.0 [2], so the test may not match current behaviour. I found no sleep-current measurement in Flux either; Ada, your July question about it went unanswered in the thread [3].

input.q: battery station lasts measures every ten minutes

judge.reason: The answer states the reference's key facts: about 14 months on two 18650 cells at a 10-minute interval, noted as an accelerated simulation, and adds only extra caveats that do not contradict it.

questions.question: What caused the cloud outage according to the post-mortem?
